subject: general
question: Choose the different one.
solution:
Identify the category of each item:

Linux ⇒ Operating System

Windows ⇒ Operating System

macOS ⇒ Operating System

Intel ⇒ Processor / Hardware company

⇒ All the given options are Operating system except 'Intel', which is a hardware.

**∴ The different one is Intel (Option 2).**
